text: I’m sorry this has happened to you. Your husband should have made you his priority and not his mother - when he married you. It sounds like your mother in law is coming between you. Not not being invited to Shabbat dinner and being intentionally excluded is a red flag. If I was you I would ask your husband to go to marriage counselling so you can express what you are feeling to him in a supportive and therapeutic environment. You say that your husband “massages” his mother and you don’t know what’s going on, and now your mother in law wants to live with you and come on vacation with you. These are serious matters that need to be resolved in counselling so you have support you need. ❤️
